subject: Startups
subcategory: The Art of the Startup Pitch
title: The Team Slide
description: A quick, practical guide to The Team Slide.

hook.text: Ideas are cheap. Execution is everything. The team slide convinces investors that these people can actually deliver.

buildup.text: Show relevant experience, not impressive titles.

discovery.text: Investors call it 'founder-market fit.' The best teams have personal connections to the problem they're solving.

twist.text: Solo founders get funded less often. Investors prefer teams of 2–3 where skills complement each other.

climax.text: The team slide isn't about bragging.

punchline.text: Investors bet on jockeys, not just horses.

quiz.question: What is 'founder-market fit'?
options: When founders have personal connection to the problem
